name: Pitons, cirques and remparts of Reunion Island
description: Covering about 40% of Réunion, a French volcanic island in the southwest Indian Ocean, this protected wilderness is a rugged world of two soaring volcanic peaks, sheer rock walls and three huge cliff-ringed basins called cirques. Forested gorges, cloud forests and heathland form a patchwork of habitats rich in plants found nowhere else. It is a favourite with hikers and mountaineers.
